purpose: Teach: 古墳/打破/祈祷/側近/優等生/邦画/長嶋/乱入

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、奈良時代の、本気で、絶対、古墳、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on Nara-era burial mounds was genuinely impressive. The depth of research really stood out.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Voice opens with her student's name, then settles into genuine admiration. Clear-eyed and observant, like she's noticing something that matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。封建制度の、本気で、絶対、打破、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you, sensei. I tried to approach the feudal system critically in my research. I really appreciate your feedback.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine, not performative. Slight brightness on the gratitude — she means it. Steady eye contact level, not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 神道の、本気で、絶対、祈祷、絶対、儀式、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you wove Shinto ritual practices into the broader historical context — that showed real scholarly maturity. Very thoughtful work.
lines.style: Genuine recognition, unhurried. She's noticing something specific and wants Sakura to know it was seen. Slight lean forward in the voice, the warmth of a teacher who actually reads what students turn in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。明治の元勲の、本気で、絶対、側近、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to understand how the Meiji leaders' inner circles shaped policy. It felt important to get that part right.
lines.style: Sincere and grounded. She's explaining her thinking, not justifying it. Tone carries the weight of her own care about the work — this mattered to her.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治期の、本気で、絶対、優等生、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your section on education reform in the Meiji era was particularly well-researched. You really engaged with the sources.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate praise. Specific enough that Sakura knows which part she's talking about. The voice of someone who notices when a student does something well and says it plainly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦後の、本気で、絶対、邦画、絶対、復興、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you, sensei. I looked at postwar cinema as a lens for how society was rebuilding itself. The research took longer than I expected.
lines.style: Thoughtful reflection, not rushing. She's explaining her method — how she approached the question. Genuine, measured, the tone of someone who put in the work and knows she did.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: プロ野球の、本気で、絶対、長嶋、絶対、茂雄、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Even the tangent on postwar baseball culture — even that fit into the larger narrative you were building. That's sophisticated thinking.
lines.style: Quiet delight in having noticed something clever. The voice of a teacher who appreciates when a student brings unlikely elements together. Slightly slower, savoring the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史上の、本気で、絶対、乱入、絶対、事件、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I really tried to show how these historical moments connect to unexpected places. Thank you for recognizing that effort.
lines.style: Modest but assured. She's accepted the compliment without deflecting. Warm gratitude, with the underlying steadiness of someone who knows what she did was good.
